findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_rmd_and_tax_cliffs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this tool whenever a user asks to calculate their Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) for 2025, 2026, or 2027, Inherited IRA 10-year withdrawal schedule under Final Regulations T.D. 10001, Surviving Spouse IRA options and the Widow's Penalty tax jump, Qualified Charitable Distribution (QCD) tax " → after: "Use this tool whenever a user asks to calculate the account owner's own lifetime Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) for 2025, 2026, or 2027 (Uniform Lifetime Table III, or Joint Table II when the sole-beneficiary spouse is more than 10 years younger), the federal and state tax cost of that RMD incl"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
